metadata.name: status
metadata.description: NON-secret reactive identity status: 'none' (no wallet), 'locked' (a persisted wallet exists, not unlocked), 'unlocked' (keyring in memory). Formulas reference this to gate UI (e.g. the formula bar / a 🔒 badge). The keyring + private keys live MODULE-SCOPE, never in a cel.

metadata.name: name
metadata.description: the wallet's profile display name (non-secret). Set via keystore.setName.

metadata.name: identity
metadata.description: the current Ed25519 PUBLIC signing key (base64) when unlocked — your public identity, used in <seg>.writers + to verify your signed edits. Empty when locked. Public, cel-safe.

metadata.name: ecdhpub
metadata.description: the current ECDH P-256 PUBLIC key (base64) when unlocked — recipients wrap a segment data key TO this. Empty when locked. Public, cel-safe.

metadata.name: keystore.sign
metadata.description: (message) -> {ok, sig, pub}. Ed25519-sign a message with the CURRENT signing key. pub identifies the key for verification (public verify = crypto.verify). Must be unlocked.

metadata.name: keystore.wrap
metadata.description: (dataKeyB64, toPubB64?) -> {ok, env, pub}. ECDH-wrap a symmetric data key to a recipient ecdh public key (default = my own = self-encryption). Store the returned pub; unwrap needs it. Must be unlocked.

metadata.name: keystore.unwrap
metadata.description: (env, withPubB64?) -> {ok, dataKey}. ECDH-unwrap with the held key whose ecdh pub matches withPub (default current; tries current+history so a now-retired key still opens). Must be unlocked.

metadata.name: keystore.has
metadata.description: () -> bool. Is there a wallet (an unlocked keyring in memory OR a persisted keystore in OPFS)?

metadata.name: keystore.create
metadata.description: (passcode, name?) -> {ok, persisted, identity, phrase}. First-run: mint an EXTRACTABLE wallet keyring (ecdh P-256 + Ed25519), seal it (PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA-256 -> AES-256-GCM) under the passcode, persist to OPFS if available (else session-only), load into memory. Returns the 12-word recovery phrase. Passcode >=4 chars and UNRECOVERABLE (no backdoor).

metadata.name: keystore.unlock
metadata.description: (passcode) -> {ok, identity}|{ok:false,error}. Read the persisted OPFS keystore, decrypt with the passcode, load the keyring into memory + write status cels. file:// has no persisted blob -> use keystore.import with a file.

metadata.name: keystore.lock
metadata.description: () -> drop the in-memory keyring (sign-out). status -> 'locked' (if a blob persists) or 'none'.

metadata.name: keystore.reshuffle
metadata.description: () -> {ok, persisted, identity, history}. Mint a NEW current keypair; retire the old one into the history list (so docs sealed to it stay openable); re-seal + persist. Must be unlocked.

metadata.name: keystore.changePasscode
metadata.description: (oldPasscode, newPasscode) -> {ok}|{ok:false,error}. Verify the old passcode (against the persisted blob), re-derive a new seal key, re-seal under the new passcode. New passcode >=4 chars, still unrecoverable.

metadata.name: keystore.setName
metadata.description: (name) -> set the profile display name, re-seal + persist. Must be unlocked.

metadata.name: keystore.export
metadata.description: () -> the sealed keystore blob as a JSON string, for DOWNLOAD (the file:// backup / device-migration artifact). Already ciphertext under the passcode; no secret leaves.

metadata.name: keystore.import
metadata.description: (blobString, passcode) -> {ok, identity, name}|{ok:false,error}. Load a keystore from a FILE (file:// / device migration): decrypt with the passcode, load into memory, persist to OPFS if available.

metadata.name: keystore.seedPhrase
metadata.description: () -> {ok, phrase}. The 12-word recovery phrase for the current wallet (display only; deterministic seed->key re-derivation is the documented follow-up - the working recovery in v1 is the exported passcode-locked file). Must be unlocked.
